statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. The Nasdaq-100 has held the same contained two-sided band for a seventh hour with both session extremes rejected and the index back at its previous close, while VIX has eased further; Stress stays elevated on the after-close Nvidia catalyst.
recommendation: Tail at 10 is well below the block threshold, so the deterministic mapping yields EA_ON. A narrow evidence-based danger window is published for 20:00-23:00 UTC, covering the Nvidia results at approximately 20:20 UTC and the 21:00 UTC conference call.
headline: Nasdaq-100 band holds a seventh hour into Nvidia's after-close report; Tail eases to 10, Stress elevated at 60
body: At the assessment cutoff the Nasdaq-100 cash index trades at 29,209.95, essentially unchanged on the day and back at its 29,209.23 previous close, still inside the 29,096.84-29,264.87 session range set from a 29,130.77 open. Both session extremes are unchanged from the previous hour and both have been rejected, making this a seventh consecutive hour of containment inside a band about 0.58% wide. Mean reversion is demonstrably functioning and no persistent one-way structure is observed. Nasdaq-100 futures near 29,279 in a 29,096.00-29,332.75 range confirm the same two-sided picture in continuous trade. VIX at 15.43 is 0.02 points lower on the day and sits near the bottom of a narrow 15.39-15.74 range, a further easing from the prior hour. The 2-year yield near 4.226% and the 10-year near 4.671% are up about 2 and 3 basis points respectively, with the 10-year at its session high, so rates are a mild conflict against a flat equity tape rather than a shared risk impulse. WTI crude near $82.17 is down about 0.2% and Brent near $87.72 is down about 1.0% after an Iran-Oman agreement on sharing Strait of Hormuz revenues, a de-escalation that removes rather than adds an energy tail channel. July PCE, released this morning, showed headline inflation at 0.2% month over month and 3.7% year over year, slightly above expectations, with core PCE at 0.2% and 3.3% year over year in line; the market response has been contained. The dominant remaining catalyst is Nvidia's fiscal second-quarter report at approximately 20:20 UTC followed by the 21:00 UTC conference call, which keeps Stress elevated at 60 even while observed Tail evidence stays weak. Shared Finviz cross-asset context collected at 18:28 UTC is fresh and corroborative rather than decisive: index futures are flat, VIX futures are lower, crude is slightly lower, and the latest-session megacap and semiconductor tapes are mixed in both directions. That delayed context was used only as confirmation, never as live price-path evidence. Tail is scored at 10 on seven hours of intact two-sided structure, rejected extremes, easing implied volatility and a de-escalating energy backdrop, with the pre-earnings dispersion carried in Stress rather than counted as an already-observed price path.

lookbackSummary: Over the past 24 hours Claude's published Tail stayed inside a 9-16 band and never reached a blocking level. Risk drifted lower through the 25 August US afternoon and overnight to a trough of 9, then held at 11 through the European morning while Stress climbed steadily from 45 to 57 as the July PCE release and the after-close Nvidia catalyst approached. The 12:00 UTC slot carried the release window at Tail 16 with an event/whipsaw mode; the 13:00 to 17:00 UTC slots then stepped Tail back down to 15, 14, 13, 12 and 11 as the post-release path proved orderly and the session range held.
outlookSummary: The published path holds Tail at 10-12 through the final cash hour and the closing auction, lifts it to a 22-24 band across the 20:00-23:00 UTC window that covers Nvidia's after-close results and conference call, then normalizes it back toward 12-15 through the Asian and European overnight hours. The maximum forecast Tail of 24 keeps the deterministic mapping at WATCH and never reaches the block threshold, because pre-event dispersion is scored as Stress rather than as an already-observed price path. A step up to 15-17 is published for the 27 August 12:30 UTC jobless-claims block and the following 13:30 UTC US cash open, which delivers the first full regular-session verdict on Nvidia.
